icons.label: Home
icons.meaning: Home or top-level destination. Do not substitute for Back.

review.note: One rounded pentagon: ACUTE_JOIN gable and shoulders, CORNER_TOKEN feet, apex on the top keyline. 16 px door is narrower and sits lower so the outline still reads as a house.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Search
icons.meaning: Find content. A heavier lens still has an open center.

review.note: Circular lens and capsule handle. The octagon is Outline; Rounded must not use it.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Plus
icons.meaning: Add or create. Distinct from expand and zoom-in.

review.note: Two crossing capsules. Round terminals are the Rounded tell versus Outline square caps.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Arrow right
icons.meaning: A literal right arrow. Navigation direction must be chosen by the application.

review.note: One continuous round-capped shaft into a round-joined head, at a 45-degree half-angle and a two-thirds-canvas span on all six drawings.
review.usage: The application chooses left/right; artwork does not auto-mirror.

review.note: Circular head over a dome torso: broad shoulder circles and smaller base corners. Outline uses an octagonal head.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: File
icons.meaning: A document. Not a duplicate action.

review.note: Portrait page with CORNER_TOKEN on its three page corners and a turned-down corner: solid in outline, where a counter would be a sub-pixel pocket, and split off by a gap-target slit in filled. Two unequal left-aligned lines at 24 px only.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

review.note: CORNER_TOKEN body with tabs and a header rail at contour weight. No date marks at 12 or 16 px; a row of three at 24 px.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Sliders
icons.meaning: Adjust parameters. Not a funnel filter or gear glyph.

review.note: Circular knobs on stadium rails. Two rows at every native size.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.

icons.label: Warning
icons.meaning: A warning requiring a visible text label in every supported appearance and native size.

review.note: ACUTE_JOIN triangle authored from its corner circles, so the apex stays on the keyline, with capsule stem and circular dot at the gap target. Visible-label restriction is concept-level.

icons.label: Link
icons.meaning: A link or related resource. Not external navigation by itself.

review.note: Two capsule rings on one 45-degree axis, woven so that each crosses over the other once, at every master and style. The weave gap is a recorded grammar exception below the meaningful-gap target. Requires a visible text label at 12 px.
review.usage: Requires a visible text label at 12 px. At 16 and 24 px, use the action name on the enclosing control.

icons.label: Branch
icons.meaning: A branching relationship. Requires a visible text label at every size.

review.note: Three circular nodes and round-joined connectors. Outline uses square nodes.
review.usage: Requires a visible text label at every size and appearance. This rule is separate from the Warning restriction record.

icons.label: Star
icons.meaning: Favorite or rating, with context. Distinct from Focus.

review.note: Five-point star with round points and round inner notches. STAR_JOIN is ~0.5× outline (0.65 / 0.85 / 1.0); 1.0×+ join collapses mass. Outer radius is sized so filled 24 mass tracks Outline (~0.27 of canvas) rather than sitting ~30% light.
review.usage: Use the action name on the enclosing control; 12 px is for labeled information.
